nodes.title: Second bound (rejected reading since rev 10, information only): the maker's top row is a true 14.8 V full-throttle point
nodes.text: the maker's 30 A row (7 500 rpm, 1 580 gf, 11x4.7, 94 degC) was taken at 14.8 V at the ESC and 100 % duty. The station then has an effective series resistance R_eff = (14.8 - w / Kv) / I_m at that row (winding at its 94 degC, ESC and everything the simple model leaves out), used unchanged at other bus voltages and with the 11x5.5MR
nodes.basis: CDR-AE-01 (review/CDR-2026-11-13/CDR-aero.md): the 'sagging supply' reading of the rows above 12 A has no evidence, so the rows are a second bound, not discarded data. A fixed series resistance is the simplest model that reproduces the row; the reviewer's cruder rule (full-throttle rpm proportional to bus voltage) is carried beside it as a sensitivity. T-E1-STAND with a logged bus voltage decides between the bounds. REJECTED in the closure round (2026-11-14, rev 10) by the maker's own published rows (CALC-E1-BOUND2-CHECK): (1) applied at the maker's 11.1 V full-throttle row with the same 11x4.7 it predicts CL-E1-B2-MISS-111 less thrust than the maker measured; (2) the five full-throttle rows, read as held-voltage points, need five different station resistances (CL-E1-R-UB-SPREAD), which no fixed station has; (3) it puts CL-E1-RM-NEEDED-B2 times the maker-stated winding resistance in the motor, and even the least pessimistic held-voltage reading needs CL-E1-RM-NEEDED-MIN times. The volts column is the 4S / 3S nominal rating, so the rows do not fix the voltage at the ESC; the resistance outside the motor belongs to the maker's rig (supply, leads, ESC), which K09-L does not carry: its own pack, harness and ESC are modelled separately (ASM-E1-PACK-CELLS, electrical.r_ext_mohm, ASM-E1-ESC)

nodes.title: Fit PER3 to the maker's X3108S + 11x4.7 table
nodes.equation: kT = mean(T_meas / T_PER3(rpm)) ; kP: sum(P_bat,model(rpm) - P_meas) = 0 over rows 5-12 A ; R_th = (94 - 25) / P_loss(30 A row) ; rows > 12 A (second bound): V_supply,min = V_m + I_m R_esc at the measured rpm, R_eff = (14.8 - w / Kv) / I_m

nodes.title: PER3 11x8E factors fitted on the X2814 V3 maker row (APC 11x8, 14.8 V)
nodes.equation: kT = T_maker / T_PER3(rpm_maker) ; kP = Q w / P_PER3(rpm_maker), Q = (I_maker - I0) / Kt (full throttle: winding = battery current; both independent of the maker's supply voltage)

nodes.title: Hover operating point per motor, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5E/EP
nodes.equation: T_m = m_gate g k_dl / (4 cos cant) ; solve rpm: T(rpm) = T_m ; I_bat, P_bat at V_bus = 14.8 V ; g/W = T_m / g / P_bat ; dT_wind = R_th P_loss

nodes.title: Full-throttle static thrust and current, all four motors
nodes.equation: duty = Q_M_SPIN_MAX (D-173b: the fixed output ceiling; was 1) ; V_bus = V_ocv - R_pack (4 I_bat + I_avn) ; T/W = 4 T_max / (m_gate g) ; cases: table basis (bus held 14.8 V, 25 degC), sag (OCV 14.4 V, R_pack, 80 degC), current limits (bus held 14.8 / 16.8 V, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Full throttle with the pack-current limiter Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX
nodes.equation: largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim ; T/W = 4 T / (m_gate g) ; cases fresh (OCV 16.8 V, 25 degC) and low (OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC), with R_pack

nodes.title: Pack-current limit that holds 25 A in the winding (11x5.5E/EP, fresh pack)
nodes.equation: solve I_lim: I_m(largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim) = I_rating ; T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) at that limit, fresh (4.20 V/cell, warm R, 25 degC winding)

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the worst pack state (E1 station model + E2 pack model)
nodes.equation: R_pack = cells R_cell k_cold + R_ext ; V_ocv = cells OCV ; largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim (station model, winding 80 degC) ; T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) ; f_sag = T_worst / T_fresh (fresh: 4.20 V/cell, warm R, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Path resistance and limiter voltage drop the thrust requirement allows
nodes.equation: R_allow (rev 10: first bound only; the second bound is information) = min over the two cases (and, for information, over the two bounds) of the R_ext at which T/W_worst(R_ext) = T/W_min,sag or T/W_fresh(R_ext) = T/W_min (bisection on the cases of CALC-E1-WORST and CALC-E1-BOUND2), each bound at its own D-148 limiter (first: I_lim, second: I_b2) ; drop_allow = 100 I_lim R_allow / V_nom (both bounds, information: 100 min(I_lim R_allow,1 , I_b2 R_allow,2) / V_nom) ; thrust cost of the path = 1 - T_worst(R_ext) / T_worst(0)

nodes.title: Second bound: the maker's rows above 12 A read as true 14.8 V points (11x5.5E/EP)
nodes.equation: R_eff from the maker's 30 A row (CALC-E1-CAL) replaces R_m + R_esc ; then as CALC-E1-WORST: largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim, T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) ; sensitivity (CDR-AE-01 rule): rpm_full = rpm_full(14.8 V held) x V_bus / 14.8 ; stand point: bus held at V_stand ; T_need = T/W_min,sag m / (4 cos cant)

nodes.title: Second bound against every published full-throttle row of the maker
nodes.equation: held-voltage reading of a full-throttle row (duty <= 1, V_ESC = V_label): V_label d = w / Kv + I_m R, I_m = I_bat / d - P_esc0 / V_label -> R <= R_ub = (V_label - w / Kv) / (I_bat - P_esc0 / V_label) (maker numbers only, no prop model) ; spread = max R_ub / min R_ub (a fixed station has one R) ; second bound at the 11.1 V 11x4.7 row: full throttle on R_eff (CALC-E1-BOUND2) at a held 11.1 V, miss = 1 - T_pred / T_maker ; R_m needed = (R - R_esc) / R_m(T_row) with R_m(T) = R_25 (1 + a (T - 25)) ; first bound at the same row: supply needed at duty 1 = V_m + I_m R_esc at the measured rpm

nodes.title: Prop stack, prop-to-structure gap, nut and motor-screw engagement
nodes.equation: s = L_body + t_base + h_hub / 2 ; x_tip = L_body + t_base + L_post ; e_nut = L_post - h_hub - t_washer - h_nut ; gap = face_ahead + s >= 0.14 D (B4) ; e_screw = L_screw - t_plate (D3 R3: plate canted with the motor, uniform under every head)

nodes.title: Propulsion flying mass, four stations, per-unit masses incl. leads
nodes.equation: m = n (motor + ESC + prop + adapter and nut + motor screws)

nodes.title: Cruise point on B1's polar: four props share the drag
nodes.equation: CL = 2W/(rho V^2 S) ; D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim (B1's as-designed polar, = CALC-B1V-CRUISE drag_gate_n) ; T_m = D / (4 cos cant) ; solve rpm: T(rpm, J) = T_m ; eta_prop = T V / P_shaft ; eta_tot = T V / P_bat ; L/D_eff = W / D ; p_check = (P_55 + avionics) / B1 gate power

nodes.title: Cruise point at the 17 m/s fallback speed (D-96 c, B6), 11x5.5E/EP
nodes.equation: as CALC-E1-CRUISE at V = 17 m/s: D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim ; T_m = D / (4 cos cant) ; P = 4 P_bat(T_m, J) ; ratio = P(17) / P(cruise_ms)

nodes.title: Thrust margin along the level pitch-over corridor (sag case, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5E/EP)

nodes.procedure: Weigh motor, stripped ESC, prop, adapter set (0.1 g); calipers: base diameter (D3 needs >= 28 mm), base bolt pattern (D3 prints 16 x 19 mm), base hole depth (>= 4.0 mm, CL-E1-HOLE-DEPTH-MIN), bell-top thread length (>= 2.5 mm for D-58; >= 3.0 mm with >= 4.0 mm free depth -> M3x5, CR-A4-43), adapter flange under the screw head, motor phase-lead length from the base (F2's routed reach 0.121 m, CL-F2-PHASE-REACH: if the leads reach, no splice and F2 returns 12 g), ESC strapped on a printed pad (height proud), body length, adapter base and post; on the first built station a printed 25 mm gauge between the blade's aft face at the tip and the CF tube, blade turned through the wing-side position (R-PROP-CLEAR); 4-wire: 2.00 A from a bench supply through two phases, read the voltage drop (R = V / I); no-load current and rpm at 10.0 V without prop (Kv = rpm / (V - I0 R))
